title: sverify sink contract record
description: What a sverify sink records with each commit (sverify.io.Contract.to_json): in a Delta commit's commitInfo and an Iceberg table's properties, under the key `sverify.contract`, or wherever a sink of your own stores it. Format 2. Within 1.x the format only gains optional keys, and readers ignore keys they do not know (docs/stability.md). Records written before 1.0 are format 1: they name the node `view`, Delta keeps them under the key `sverify`, and a record without `format` was written before 0.5. Readers map them.

plan.description: sha256 of the plan as Lean wrote it, in hex.

sources.description: The version of every source table the state was computed from, by source name.

epoch.description: The sum of the source versions: identifies the commit for exactly-once writes.

not_null.description: Columns the node proves NOT NULL.

checks.description: The other row conditions the node proves, as SQL, by constraint name (`sverify_1`, ...).

unique.description: Column sets the node proves unique.

digests.description: A content digest of each static table (StaticSource) and each source that cannot restore (a Source without restore) the node read, by source name.

cursors.description: The cursor of each source whose cursors last across processes (Source.restore), at its version in `sources`, as sverify.io._common.cursor_json encodes it: JSON values, and other values tagged as {"$cursor": <type>, "value": ...}.

table_ids.description: The id of each source table that has one (a Delta table's metaData.id), at its version in `sources`.
